beats.text: Close on the phone screen: a cluttered, messy to-do list of scattered, overlapping, jumbled task lines in different sizes.
The jumbled task lines smoothly slide, sort and snap into a neat, organized daily timeline of evenly spaced blue blocks from morning to evening.
Calm blue card with the app name in clean white letters and a short tagline below.

Your 8-second ClearDay ad is ready:

- **0–6 s:** a white phone with a pale blue-and-white app screen. A jumbled to-do list slides and sorts itself into a neat timeline of blue blocks, morning to evening.
- **6–8 s:** an end card in calm blue (#2F6FD6) with "ClearDay" in white and the tagline "Your messy list, made into a clear day." The card was drawn by code, so the letters and colour come out exactly right.

**What I checked:** the length, the shape, the silence and the 2-second end card are all correct. I couldn't watch the 6-second phone clip myself, so I haven't confirmed that the messy-to-organized change looks right. The AI video model also makes up any text inside the app screen, so the task lines may be blurry shapes rather than real words.

It used 144 credits. If that part misses, I can make it again with a different prompt, or change the tagline or the card colour.
